//: Always-on enterprise skills hook. Merge the "hooks" block below into your settings.json (merge, do not replace the whole file). SessionStart injects the directive into the main agent; SubagentStart injects it into every spawned subagent. Both run emit-directive.mjs in EXEC form ("command":"node" + "args"), which uses NO shell, so the hook does not silently fail when bash is missing or broken. Place emit-directive.mjs and enterprise-skills-always-on.md together (the emitter reads the directive as its own sibling), e.g. both in .claude/ for a project install or both in ~/.claude/ for a personal install.
//requires: Node.js on PATH, and a Claude Code version that supports exec-form hook "args" (if yours does not, the command will not run; use the confirm-it-works check and the PowerShell fallback below). Check: `node --version` and `claude --version`.
//personal: For a personal (all-projects) install there is no project-dir placeholder, so use an ABSOLUTE path to the emitter in args[0], e.g. "C:/Users/you/.claude/emit-directive.mjs" or "/home/you/.claude/emit-directive.mjs". For a project install, keep "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/emit-directive.mjs" (Claude Code substitutes ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} itself).
//windows-fallback: If exec form does not run on your machine (Windows setups are the usual culprit), replace an entry with the PowerShell shell form (shell and args cannot be combined): { "type": "command", "shell": "powershell", "timeout": 10, "command": "node \"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/emit-directive.mjs\" SessionStart" }. Then confirm a fresh session actually receives the directive (see always-on/README.md, 'Confirm it works').
//edit-gate: The edit-time select/load gate (ADR-0098, issue #175). PreToolUse on the file-editing tools (Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) HOLDS a source edit until the task has a selection record and every required/applies skill was loaded this session; PostToolUse on Skill records a genuine load; SessionStart matcher 'compact' flags the selected skills to re-load after a compaction. The installer sets ESK_SELECTION (the task's selection record path), ESK_LOADED (the load-state path), and ESK_SKILLS_DIR per session; these paths MUST live outside the work tree. Where ESK_SELECTION is unset the gate is a no-op so it never breaks unrelated work. Bash is intentionally NOT matched here: gating all Bash would deny read-only commands (ls, git status) before a selection can be written, and files written through Bash are backstopped by the Stop finish-check (issue #174).

SessionStart.//: After a COMPACTION (main-thread compaction fires SessionStart with source=compact), the selected skills' bodies are gone from context. This clears them from the load-state and names them so they are re-loaded with the Skill tool before the next edit (the edit-gate then holds until they are). It does NOT inline the bodies: a single real SKILL.md exceeds the 10,000-char additionalContext cap, so inlining would deliver nothing yet mark them loaded. Needs ESK_SELECTION (+ ESK_SKILLS_DIR, ESK_LOADED) set per session by the installer.
